summary: Re-test of the 6 iteration_23 defects plus regression of the sub-subcategory level. Backend: 13 new pytest cases (/app/backend/tests/test_subsub_iter24.py) - all PASSED - covering cross-level listing guards, duplicate-label depth logic, admin listing + soft delete visibility, product 4-level chain validation/filter and search-resolve. Frontend E2E (Playwright, public URL): seeded 'QA24 Type A' under Rice > Basmati Rice (3 legacy products) and verified the 'All <subcategory>' chip appears FIRST, shows all 3 products (legacy included) while the specific chip shows only 1; strict drill-down (prompt, 0 products) preserved before/after chip deselect and on breadcrumb up-navigation; 4-level breadcrumb Home>Rice>Basmati Rice>QA24 Type A; /cart and /nonexistent-xyz now redirect to /. Admin: AdminProducts table shows 'Rice > Basmati Rice > QA24 Type A' breadcrumb per row; filter bar and product-dialog sub-subcategory selects exclude deactivated records; /admin/subsubcategories create/edit/delete with dependent Category->Subcategory selects works and duplicate shows 'Sub-subcategory ... already exists here' toast. Regression: brand/price/discount/in-stock filters, clear all, product detail, add-to-cart, cart badge 1->2, cart drawer totals, search not_found + available. Auth playbook re-verified: bcrypt $2b$ hash, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookies, allow_credentials with explicit CORS_ORIGINS, 429 lockout after 4 failed logins. ALL test data cleaned up (seed reverted, 44 leftover inactive TEST_*/QA* category docs and 3 inactive TEST_PROD products purged, test customer cart cleared).

issues: Stock column renders '-' for the tested product (stock is location-scoped inventory); if intentional consider showing 'per-location' hint instead of a bare dash
'Clear all' keeps subsubcategory=all in the URL (attribute filters cleared, drill-down retained). Likely intentional, flagged only for confirmation
Page lists inactive (soft-deleted) rows with no active/inactive filter or toggle, so the list grows indefinitely. Accepted per the review request, but an is_active filter would help

critical_code_review_comments: categories.py cross-level guards are correct now, but the two list endpoints duplicate the same pattern; consider a shared _list_level(parent_ids, parent_id) helper to keep future levels consistent.

Products.js uses the magic string 'all' for the sentinel in multiple places (URL param, chip state, product query). Extract to a constant to avoid a future sub-subcategory whose id is literally 'all' colliding.
DELETE/GET /api/cart require location_id as a mandatory query param (422 without it) - fine but undocumented; keep in mind for any future client.

ALL reverted/purged - DB has zero TEST_/QA* categories and no active sub-subcategories remaining; test customer cart cleared.

rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable - no defects reproduced this iteration. Previous root causes confirmed fixed: (a) query['parent_id'] overwriting the level {$in} guard -> now an explicit membership check returning []; (b) drill-down filtered strictly by subsubcategory_id -> 'all' sentinel chip omits the filter so legacy null rows are reachable; (c) missing Route path='*' -> Navigate to '/'; (d) duplicate label used only parent_id presence -> now inspects parent depth; (e) admin selects fed by admin listing incl. inactive -> activeOnly() filter; (f) table showed only top category -> breadcrumb cell.
